source_notes: Re-verified 2026-06-04 against non-GEM sources (the prior GEM self-citation was removed per anti-circularity rule). Status 'proposed' (a pre-construction lifecycle status) corroborated off-GEM by three independent origins: (1) AMACO's own project page (sponsor primary) describes the Mombasa LNG-to-Power & NG Transmission System Development as in the 'permitting phase' with PlannedStartYear 2027, 10.5 bcm/yr (6.2 mtpa) regas, 1,500 MW CCGT, and a 485.8 km Mombasa-Nairobi pipeline — url_verifier PASS on tokens '6.2 mtpa','permitting','2027'; (2) LNG Prime (independent trade press) reports the Mombasa LNG-import-terminal work is at feasibility-study stage (K&M Advisors / KenGen) — PASS on 'feasibility','Mombasa'; (3) Petroleum Africa describes the same Mombasa regasification facility as a not-yet-built tender/feasibility project — PASS on 'regasification'. No FID, EPC award, construction start, or cancellation found in 2025-2026 reporting; the project remains pre-construction, so the GEM 'proposed' status is current and unchanged. Note: the literal word 'proposed' is GEM-internal lifecycle vocabulary and does not appear verbatim on any source page; the corroboration is the substantive pre-construction (feasibility/permitting, planned 2027) stage, which is what the 'proposed' status encodes. Representative blue re-verify for the terminal (standard tier).
scope_note: Project-level status applies to the unit-row; Original Proposal (separate unit) remains 'shelved' (see qa).
